alexc: Heads up — uploaded the GPTQ family bake results for Llama / Mistral / Qwen. noticed asymmetric KV sensitivity on Mistral, putting notes below.

mariaw: link? top-line numbers pls.

alexc: quick TL;DR:
- Llama-2-13b (GPTQ 4-bit per-channel): small accuracy delta on instruction/eval sets (~0.5-1.2% absolute drop on closed-book QA, <1% on chat metrics). latency improvements ~18%.
- Mistral-7b (GPTQ 4-bit, default blocksize): big degradation on long-prefix KV tests (prefix >= 2k). QA EM drop 3.8-6.1% depending on prefix, callbacks fail sometimes. latency up ~12% on CPU fallback paths.
- Qwen-7b (GPTQ hybrid): accuracy mostly preserved (<0.7% delta), but token latency higher vs Llama (~8% due to attention code-gen mismatch).

tj_h: what GPTQ config did you use for Mistral? per-channel or per-tensor? micro-batching?

alexc: GPTQ args we used: 
```
--mode=gptq 
--bits=4 
--group-size=128 
--per-channel=true 
--act-order=colwise 
--kv-cache=true
```
Also tested block-size 64/128/256 sweep. Mistral sensitivity increases when group-size <=64.

bakebot: Perf CI: run/3359999-kv-sweep finished — 46 tests, 3 failed (mistral-kv-prefix-2048*, mistral-kv-prefix-4096*, inference-regression-check). Logs: https://ci.redwood/example/3359999

samr: Did you compare AWQ / FP8 on the same models or only GPTQ? any stability tradeoffs?

alexc: Ran AWQ and FP8 on a smaller subset: 
- AWQ on Mistral: better latency (10-20% lower) and smaller KV drop vs GPTQ, but higher instability on instruction-following / hallucination on our LLM-evals (hallucination up ~2-3% on some tasks).
- FP8 on Qwen: promising throughput, but tooling/ops risk (quant kernels still experimental).
Numbers: Mistral GPTQ 4-bit KV-drop ~5% at prefix 4k, AWQ ~2% at same prefix but +1.5% hallucination metric.

jing: For deployment recommendations: which quant profile to push to canary Dedicated vs hosted?

alexc: Recommendation: 
- Llama-2-13b: GPTQ4 per-channel safe for hosted and dedicated; put behind quick canary for instruction suite.
- Mistral-7b: prefer AWQ/FP8 on Dedicated (where we control kernels / H100 fp8 path). If must run GPTQ on hosted, only allow up to prefix=1024 and keep automatic fallback to FP8 variant for long sessions.
- Qwen-7b: GPTQ acceptable but tune attention kernel; enable small scheduling fuzz to hide latency spikes.

mariaw: can you kick a KV-length sweep for Mistral + AWQ vs GPTQ and include instruction + hallucination evals?

alexc: Yup — queuing jobs now. naming: kv-sweep-mistral-3359999. will include evals: llm-eval-suite, long-context-qa, instruction-coherence. :+1:

buildbot: Job queued: kv-sweep-mistral-3359999 -> queued on cluster gptq-sweep-2 (ETA ~3h).

alexc: Actionable summary for next steps:
1) Do KV-length sweep (64/256/1k/2k/4k) for Mistral comparing GPTQ/AWQ/FP8.
2) Add hallucination + instruction-following evals to sweep.
3) For Hosted: pin Mistral-GPTQ behind canary with auto-fallback to FP8 when prefix >1024 or when regressions triggered.
4) Update docs + rollout plan + operator runbook (how to detect KV degradation and flip fallbacks).

tj_h: can you attach the raw eval csvs when available? easier to slice.

alexc: will push CSV + perf traces to the bake artifacts bucket under s3://bakes/3359999 once complete.

samr: thanks — this is great. will prep a quick ops runbook draft.

alexc: cheers. I'll post a follow-up thread with the sweep results. :eyes:
